## Specification

### Component: Avatar

A person or account: an image with an initials fallback, optional presence dot, and overlapping groups. `Avatar`, `AvatarFallback`, `AvatarGroup` are Server Component–safe; `AvatarImage` is a client component (load errors).

#### Anatomy
- `<span class="ui-avatar [ui-avatar-<size>] [ui-avatar-rounded]">` containing `<img class="ui-avatar-image" data-state="loading|loaded">`, `<span class="ui-avatar-fallback">` and an optional `<span class="ui-avatar-status" data-status role="img" aria-label>`.
- `AvatarGroup`: `<div role="group" class="ui-avatar-group [ui-avatar-group-<size>]">`; `max` shows N avatars then a "+N" avatar.
- `getInitials(name)` returns up to two uppercase initials.

#### Props
- `Avatar`: `size` `xs` 24 · `sm` 32 · `md` 40 (default, inherited from a group) · `lg` 48 · `xl` 64; `shape` `circle` | `rounded` (radius = size × .28); `status` `online|away|busy|offline`; `statusLabel`.
- `AvatarImage`: `src`, required `alt`. Renders nothing on error (or if `src` is empty); also handles images that failed before hydration.

#### Visual rules
- Size is `--ui-avatar-size`; font-size `max(12px, size × .36)`, weight 500, uppercase.
- Image and fallback share one grid cell (image on top); the fallback is hidden once the image has loaded (`:has(> .ui-avatar-image[data-state="loaded"])`).
- Fallback fill `--ui-secondary`, text `--ui-secondary-foreground`. A 1px inset hairline (`foreground` 10%) is drawn over the picture.
- Status dot: `max(8px, size × .27)`, bottom-right, fill online `--ui-success`, away `--ui-warning`, busy `--ui-destructive`, offline `--ui-muted-foreground`, ring `0 0 0 2px var(--ui-avatar-ring, var(--ui-background))`.
- Group: avatars overlap by size × .28, each ringed with `--ui-avatar-ring`.

#### Accessibility
- `alt` is the person's name (`""` only if the name is printed beside it). The status dot has an accessible name. The group has `role="group"`; give it an `aria-label`.

#### Acceptance checks
- A broken image shows the initials. Sizes measure 24/32/40/48/64. The group "+N" counts the hidden avatars.

## Files

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

### `ui/components/avatar/avatar-image.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useCallback, useState, type ImgHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export interface AvatarImageProps extends ImgHTMLAttributes<HTMLImageElement> {
  /** Required: the person's name. Pass `alt=""` only when the name is shown next to the avatar. */
  alt: string;
}

/**
 * The picture. Renders nothing if it fails to load, so `AvatarFallback`
 * underneath shows instead. Also copes with an image that failed before
 * hydration (server-rendered markup never fires `onError`).
 */
export const AvatarImage = forwardRef<HTMLImageElement, AvatarImageProps>(function AvatarImage(
  { className, src, onLoad, onError, alt, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  // Keyed by src, so a new src starts a fresh attempt without an effect
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ src?: AvatarImageProps['src']; state: 'loading' | 'loaded' | 'error' }>({ state: 'loading' });
  const state = result.src === src ? result.state : 'loading';
  const setState = (next: 'loaded' | 'error') => setResult({ src, state: next });

  const ref = useCallback(
    (img: HTMLImageElement | null) => {
      if (typeof forwardedRef === 'function') forwardedRef(img);
      else if (forwardedRef) forwardedRef.current = img;
      if (img?.complete) setState(img.naturalWidth > 0 ? 'loaded' : 'error');
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [forwardedRef, src],
  );

  if (!src || state === 'error') return null;
  return (
    <img
      ref={ref}
      src={src}
      alt={alt}
      data-state={state}
      className={cn('ui-avatar-image', className)}
      onLoad={(e) => {
        setState('loaded');
        onLoad?.(e);
      }}
      onError={(e) => {
        setState('error');
        onError?.(e);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/avatar/avatar.tsx`

```tsx
import { Children, forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type AvatarSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
export type AvatarShape = 'circle' | 'rounded';
export type AvatarStatus = 'online' | 'away' | 'busy' | 'offline';

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
  online: 'Online',
  away: 'Away',
  busy: 'Busy',
  offline: 'Offline',
};

export interface AvatarProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
  /** 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 / 64px. Without it the size is inherited from an AvatarGroup, else 40px. */
  size?: AvatarSize;
  /** `circle` (default) or `rounded` (a rounded square, for organisations and products). */
  shape?: AvatarShape;
  /** A presence dot on the bottom-right corner, with a ring in the surface colour. */
  status?: AvatarStatus;
  /** Accessible name for the status dot. Defaults to "Online", "Away"… */
  statusLabel?: string;
}

/** Up to two initials from a name: "Amina Rahman" gives "AR". */
export function getInitials(name: string) {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return '';
  const first = parts[0]![0]!;
  const last = parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1]![0]! : '';
  return (first + last).toUpperCase();
}

/**
 * Avatar — a person or account. Compose with `AvatarImage` (hides itself if
 * the image fails) and `AvatarFallback` (initials or an icon, always rendered
 * underneath). Server Component–safe; only AvatarImage is a client component.
 */
export const Avatar = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, AvatarProps>(function Avatar(
  { size, shape = 'circle', status, statusLabel, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <span
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-avatar', size && `ui-avatar-${size}`, shape === 'rounded' && 'ui-avatar-rounded', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {status && <span className="ui-avatar-status" data-status={status} role="img" aria-label={statusLabel ?? STATUS_LABEL[status]} />}
    </span>
  );
});

export interface AvatarFallbackProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {}

/** Initials (or an icon) shown until the image loads, or when there is none. */
export const AvatarFallback = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, AvatarFallbackProps>(function AvatarFallback(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-avatar-fallback', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface AvatarGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Size for every avatar in the group. */
  size?: AvatarSize;
  /** Show at most this many avatars, then a "+N" avatar for the rest. */
  max?: number;
}

/**
 * Overlapping avatars with a ring in the background colour (set
 * `--ui-avatar-ring` on the group when it sits on a card or other surface).
 */
export const AvatarGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AvatarGroupProps>(function AvatarGroup(
  { size, max, className, children, role = 'group', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const items = Children.toArray(children);
  const visible: ReactNode[] = max !== undefined && items.length > max ? items.slice(0, max) : items;
  const extra = items.length - visible.length;
  return (
    <div ref={ref} role={role} className={cn('ui-avatar-group', size && `ui-avatar-group-${size}`, className)} {...props}>
      {visible}
      {extra > 0 && (
        <Avatar>
          <AvatarFallback title={`${extra} more`}>+{extra}</AvatarFallback>
        </Avatar>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/avatar.css`

```css
/* Avatar ------------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-avatar  + size: -xs -sm -lg -xl (md default; inherited from a group)
               + -rounded (rounded square)
   Parts: .ui-avatar-image (data-state loading|loaded), .ui-avatar-fallback,
          .ui-avatar-status[data-status="online|away|busy|offline"]
   Group: .ui-avatar-group (+ -xs … -xl) overlaps its avatars with a ring in
          --ui-avatar-ring (default: the page background).
   Size lives in --ui-avatar-size so a group can set it for every child.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-avatar {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-grid;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    place-items: stretch;
    width: var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem);
    height: var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    vertical-align: middle;
    font-size: max(0.75rem, calc(var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem) * 0.36));
    line-height: 1;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .ui-avatar-xs { --ui-avatar-size: 1.5rem; }
  .ui-avatar-sm { --ui-avatar-size: 2rem; }
  .ui-avatar-md { --ui-avatar-size: 2.5rem; }
  .ui-avatar-lg { --ui-avatar-size: 3rem; }
  .ui-avatar-xl { --ui-avatar-size: 4rem; }
  .ui-avatar-rounded { border-radius: calc(var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem) * 0.28); }

  /* Image and fallback share one grid cell; the image sits on top */
  .ui-avatar-image,
  .ui-avatar-fallback { grid-area: 1 / 1; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; }
  .ui-avatar-image { position: relative; z-index: 1; object-fit: cover; }
  .ui-avatar-fallback {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background-color: var(--ui-secondary);
    color: var(--ui-secondary-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .ui-avatar-fallback > svg { width: 50%; height: 50%; }
  /* Once the picture has loaded, hide the fallback so a transparent image is not tinted */
  .ui-avatar:has(> .ui-avatar-image[data-state="loaded"]) > .ui-avatar-fallback { visibility: hidden; }

  /* Hairline over the picture so light photos keep an edge */
  .ui-avatar::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    border-radius: inherit;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 10%, transparent);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* Presence dot */
  .ui-avatar-status {
    --ui-avatar-status-color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;
    inset-inline-end: 0;
    inset-block-end: 0;
    width: max(0.5rem, calc(var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem) * 0.27));
    height: max(0.5rem, calc(var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem) * 0.27));
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-avatar-status-color);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ui-avatar-ring, var(--ui-background));
  }
  .ui-avatar-status[data-status="online"] { --ui-avatar-status-color: var(--ui-success); }
  .ui-avatar-status[data-status="away"] { --ui-avatar-status-color: var(--ui-warning); }
  .ui-avatar-status[data-status="busy"] { --ui-avatar-status-color: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-avatar:not(.ui-avatar-rounded) > .ui-avatar-status { inset-inline-end: 2%; inset-block-end: 2%; }

  /* Group */
  .ui-avatar-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; isolation: isolate; }
  .ui-avatar-group-xs { --ui-avatar-size: 1.5rem; }
  .ui-avatar-group-sm { --ui-avatar-size: 2rem; }
  .ui-avatar-group-md { --ui-avatar-size: 2.5rem; }
  .ui-avatar-group-lg { --ui-avatar-size: 3rem; }
  .ui-avatar-group-xl { --ui-avatar-size: 4rem; }
  .ui-avatar-group > .ui-avatar { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ui-avatar-ring, var(--ui-background)); }
  .ui-avatar-group > .ui-avatar + .ui-avatar { margin-inline-start: calc(var(--ui-avatar-size, 2.5rem) * -0.28); }
}
```

## Usage

**Sizes and shapes** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/avatar/sizes.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/ui/components/avatar';

/** A placeholder portrait: an abstract gradient, so the example needs no network. */
const portrait = (hue: number) =>
  `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(
    `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 80 80"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="hsl(${hue} 70% 62%)"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="hsl(${hue + 50} 65% 40%)"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="80" height="80" fill="url(#g)"/><circle cx="40" cy="32" r="14" fill="white" fill-opacity=".85"/><path d="M12 80c2-18 14-26 28-26s26 8 28 26z" fill="white" fill-opacity=".85"/></svg>`,
  )}`;

export default function AvatarSizes() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4">
        {(['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((size, i) => (
          <Avatar key={size} size={size}>
            <AvatarImage src={portrait(200 + i * 40)} alt="Amina Rahman" />
            <AvatarFallback>AR</AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4">
        {(['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((size) => (
          <Avatar key={size} size={size} shape="rounded">
            <AvatarFallback>NV</AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
